pick_implementation.title: SmartFilterPro — Choose where to sign in
pick_implementation.description: Choose SmartFilterPro. The development option is only for testing when SmartFilterPro support asks you to.

auth.title: Sign in with SmartFilterPro
auth.description: A SmartFilterPro page opens. Sign in the way you do in the SmartFilterPro app (Apple, Google or email), then choose Allow.

hvac.title: Select Thermostat
hvac.description: Your SmartFilterPro account has several Home Assistant thermostats. Choose the one to link.

climate.title: Choose Thermostat Entity
climate.description: Pick the Home Assistant climate entity to forward to SmartFilterPro.

abort.no_thermostats_found: Your SmartFilterPro account has no Home Assistant thermostat yet. Add one in the SmartFilterPro app, then add this integration again.
abort.already_configured: This SmartFilterPro thermostat is already set up in Home Assistant.
abort.oauth_error: SmartFilterPro returned an incomplete sign-in. Try again.
abort.oauth_failed: SmartFilterPro didn't accept the sign-in. Try again; if it keeps happening, check the Home Assistant log for the reason.
abort.oauth_timeout: SmartFilterPro took too long to answer. Try again.
abort.oauth_unauthorized: SmartFilterPro refused the sign-in. Try again.
abort.oauth_implementation_unavailable: Sign in with SmartFilterPro is unavailable right now. Try again later.
abort.authorize_url_timeout: Timed out preparing the sign-in page. Try again.
abort.missing_configuration: Sign in with SmartFilterPro isn't set up in this version of the integration. Reinstall it from HACS.
abort.missing_credentials: Sign in with SmartFilterPro isn't set up in this version of the integration. Reinstall it from HACS.
abort.no_url_available: Home Assistant has no address SmartFilterPro can send you back to. Turn on My Home Assistant (included in the default configuration) and try again. More: {docs_url}
abort.user_rejected_authorize: The sign-in was cancelled on SmartFilterPro ({error}).
